data.one_liner: Windows file and directory picker using native dialog controls
data.what_it_does: Provides a high‑level API to open file, save, and directory dialogs on Windows. It wraps the Win32 common dialog APIs via FFI, offering filtering, custom places, and automatic owner window detection.
use_when: Need to pick one or multiple files in a Flutter Windows app
Need to select a directory or save a file
Want to filter files by type or add custom navigation places
Want the dialog to open as a modal in front of the Flutter window
avoid_when: Building a custom file picker UI
Using only Dart without native dialogs
strengths: Automatic modal behavior with Flutter window
Easy to use API with filtering and custom places
